why_no_production_delta: All three food/form concepts are semantically resolvable, but none has an accepted new production full nutrient-vector authority in this operation.
Parsley root is not yet ordinary default-pool eligible under the accepted Russian food-market policy.
Optional rice lacks an exact source-authorized cooked-garnish producer/output binding without batch scaling or fat-allocation ambiguity.
Carrot-vs-turnip remains a strong source family alternative but lacks candidate-specific applicable kitchen/testing evidence required by the accepted verified_substitution gate.
resolved_research_questions: Крупа рисовая is broader than current long-grain RICE_WHITE and should be a distinct identity if later promoted.
Молоко пастеризованное 3,2% is a distinct standardized and mass-market Russian form.
Петрушка (корень) is distinct from parsley leaf and commercially available, but current evidence is specialty/limited for default use.
Recipes 747/748 are plausible rice-output producers but cannot be silently bound to recipe 267.
1973/1982/1987 evidence strongly corroborates the carrot-or-turnip culinary family without satisfying the project-specific tested-substitution gate.

proposed_follow_ups.goal: Obtain and review production-grade full nutrient/profile provenance for the three exact food forms and decide which, if any, may be promoted.
Run or obtain a candidate-specific kitchen verification package for the complete carrot and turnip branches and clarify the exact optional-rice garnish process/batch applicability.
